name: ビデオ反射の一貫性
description: ビデオフレーム全体で表面と目の反射の不整合を検出します。
useCase: Identifying ディープフェイクs through 反射 異常 in eyes, glasses, and reflective surfaces
mechanism: 分析します specular highlights and 反射s in eyes, glasses, and other reflective surfaces for consistency with the environment. AI生成の videos frequently produce incorrect corneal 反射s, mismatched specular highlights, or physically impossible 反射 パターン.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 75-88% on face-focused ディープフェイクs
source: Hu, S. et al. (2021) - Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights, ICASSP
algorithm: Corneal Reflection Detection + Specular Highlight Tracking + Cross-Frame Consistency
parameters: Eye 検出: landmark-based, Reflection extraction: 閾値ing + clustering, Consistency: 相関
strengths:
• 物理的に不可能な反射を検出
• 環境マッピングの不整合を発見
• AI生成で反射の一貫性維持が困難
• 照明分析と高い補完性
limitations:
• 反射面が少ないシーンでは効果薄
• 複雑な反射環境で解析が困難
• 計算コストが高い
• 低解像度で反射ディテールが不足

references.title: Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.
Guo, X. et al. (2022). Eyes Tell All: Detecting Political Orientation from Eye Movement Data. AAAI.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACV.
